ne555.name: NE555 (PDIP-8)
ne555.description: Single bipolar timer for oscillators and pulse generation.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: Trigger input: below approximately 1/3 VCC sets the latch.

pins.name: /RST
pins.description: Active-low reset; hold high for normal operation.

pins.name: CONT
pins.description: Control voltage; normally bypass to ground with 10 nF.

pins.name: THRES
pins.description: Threshold input: above approximately 2/3 VCC resets the latch.

pins.name: DISCH
pins.description: Open-collector discharge path for timing capacitor.

notes: Decouple the supply close to the IC. RESET is active low.

layout.orientation: Top view; notch up. Pin 1 at upper left; numbers run counterclockwise.

ne555.ascii_art:
NE555 (PDIP-8) [ne555]
Single bipolar timer for oscillators and pulse generation.
Package: PDIP-8 | Supply: 4.5-16 V
Top view; notch up. Pin 1 at upper left; numbers run counterclockwise.

            +-------+
  [GND] GND | 1   8 | [PWR] VCC  
 [ANA] TRIG | 2   7 | [CTL] DISCH
   [IO] OUT | 3   6 | [ANA] THRES
 [CTL] /RST | 4   5 | [ANA] CONT 
            +-------+

PWR power | GND ground | IO digital | ANA analog | BUS interface | CTL control | NC unused

pcm5102a.name: PCM5102A (TSSOP-20)
pcm5102a.description: Stereo I2S audio DAC with hardware configuration.

pins.name: VNEG
pins.description: Negative charge-pump output; bypass as specified.

pins.name: SCK
pins.description: System clock; tie low for supported PLL-based clocking.

pins.name: FMT
pins.description: Audio format selection: low I2S, high left-justified.

pins.name: XSMT
pins.description: Soft mute: low mutes, high unmutes.

pins.name: LDOO
pins.description: Internal regulator output; bypass only, do not power external loads.

notes: Map is the IC TSSOP package, not a six-pin DAC breakout. Follow datasheet charge-pump and regulator capacitor requirements. Outputs are line-level, not speaker drivers.
